history.summary: A freehold residential shophouse on Changi Road (D14), 2,293 sqft at $2.45M / $1,068 psf — not a condo. The low PSF is a strip-format artifact; shophouses are an illiquid, specialist asset class the condo framework can't properly price, with no built_year and no URA condo comps.
history.rating_rationale: This is a freehold shophouse, not a stratified condo — the $1,068 psf cannot be compared to apartment PSF, and the 2,293 sqft / $2.45M quantum sits in a niche, illiquid commercial-residential market with a very narrow buyer pool. No built_year and no URA transaction match means the algorithm is essentially guessing (score_1000 691 is unreliable here). Shophouses can be excellent assets for the right specialist buyer, but as an investment graded on the condo rubric this is out-of-scope and uncertain — Neutral with low confidence.
